name: Securities Delivery Obligation
definition: Obligation for one party to deliver securities to another party.

CCPEligibility.name: CCP Eligibility
CCPEligibility.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction is CCP (Central Counterparty) eligible.

NettingEligibility.name: Netting Eligibility
NettingEligibility.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction is eligible for netting.

TransferInstructionDate.name: Transfer Instruction Date
TransferInstructionDate.definition: Date at which the instructing party places the transfer instruction.

TransferCurrency.name: Transfer Currency
TransferCurrency.definition: Identifies the currency to be used to transfer the holdings.

SettlementInstructionGeneration.name: Settlement Instruction Generation
SettlementInstructionGeneration.definition: Specifies whether the ETC provider should generate settlement instructions or not.

SettlementDateCode.name: Settlement Date Code
SettlementDateCode.definition: Requested date of trade settlement, in coded form, for example, trade date +1).

RelatedCorporateAction.name: Related Corporate Action
RelatedCorporateAction.definition: Corporate action processes which are the source of the securities delivery obligation.

RelatedCollateralMovement.name: Related Collateral Movement
RelatedCollateralMovement.definition: Collateral movement which is the source of the obligation.

SecuritiesTradeExecution.name: Securities Trade Execution
SecuritiesTradeExecution.definition: Specifies the trade which originates the delivery obligation.

RelatedPortfolioTransfer.name: Related Portfolio Transfer
RelatedPortfolioTransfer.definition: Portfolio transfer which is the source of the securities delivery obligation.

SecuritiesTransfer.name: Securities Transfer
SecuritiesTransfer.definition: Completion of a securities settlement instruction, wherein securities are delivered/debited from a securities account and received/credited to the designated securities account.

SecuritiesLending.name: Securities Lending
SecuritiesLending.definition: Securities lending process which covers the delivery of securities by the seller.
